title: Apple Drop Salt E-Liquid – Double Apple 30ml
description:
Description
The classic pairing of red fuji apple and tangy green granny smith for that sour kick.
Apple Drop Salt is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems.
Apple Drop
